# Instructions for using the eGD

A eID.li is required to access the eGD portal. If you do not yet have an eID.li but would like to benefit from the advantages of the electronic health dossier, you can obtain one by visiting the Passport Office (APA) in Vaduz in person.

If you do not have an eID, you can take actions in the eGD (e.g., delete documents or file an objection) using the forms provided.

## Instructions for logging into the eGD

Having trouble logging in? You can log in to eGD on both your PC and your smartphone. In case of any confusion, you will find step-by-step instructions on how to log in here. These are, however, not available in english.

Instruction login on smartphone

Instruction Login on PC

## Explanatory video about eGD

The following video contains, among other things, explanations of the following actions in the eGD:

  * Access to your own eGD
  * Viewing personal documents (such as findings, lab reports)
  * Downloading personal documents
  * Management of personal documents (for example, deletion or adjustment confidentiality level)
  * View access log
  * Management access permissions of healthcare providers

## PDF instruction eGD

[pdf] Anleitung elektronisches Gesundheitsdossier Fürstentum Liechtenstein

For more general information on eGD, see the Questions & Answers Catalog.
